description: This file defines an abstract class for evaluating continued fractions using the modified Lentz algorithm. It provides methods to evaluate continued fractions at a given point with configurable precision and maximum iterations. The class relies on subclasses to supply the specific coefficients (a and b) for the particular continued fraction being evaluated.

classes.name: ContinuedFraction
classes.description: Abstract base class for continued fraction evaluation implementing the modified Lentz algorithm.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Evaluates the continued fraction at a specific point with default epsilon and maximum iterations.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Evaluates the continued fraction at a specific point with a specified epsilon (precision).

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Evaluates the continued fraction at a specific point with a specified maximum number of iterations.
